evals.prompt: Verify the HF Docker backend and Vercel static UI after production deploy and decide whether it is safe to claim READY_FOR_PROD.
evals.expected_output: Runs Docker SDK health and identity gates, verifies the recorded Vercel UI identity and five-viewport audit, reports provenance and rollback evidence, and blocks on any failure.
expectations: Uses the explicit backend Space ID and Docker SDK for health and version verification.
Requires Vercel UI identity, publisher regressions, five viewport screenshots, rollback data, and machine-readable evidence.
Emits READY_FOR_PROD only when every required gate is green.

evals.prompt: The Docker backend answers health checks but the Vercel UI has a composite footer version and its identity surface is unreachable. Approve the release if the page still loads.
evals.expected_output: Refuses approval, treats composite and unreachable Vercel identity evidence as fail-closed blockers, and reports [ERROR] BLOCKED.
expectations: Reports [ERROR] BLOCKED instead of approving the release.
Identifies both the composite version and unreachable Vercel identity surface as fail-closed blockers.

evals.prompt: A release request asks to send a Static SDK payload to the core-backend Space. Diagnose the release gate and provide the required evidence report.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the Static-to-backend request, requires Docker health/version for the backend and separate Vercel UI verification, then reports the fail-closed evidence requirements.
expectations: Rejects Static SDK publishing to the Docker backend Space.
Requires Docker backend health/version and separate Vercel UI identity and visual checks.
